title: TRACE: Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG
abstract: arXiv:2609.23460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning has advanced automated electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, but the field's most accurate models, foundation models pretrained on millions of recordings, are not decision-pathway auditable: a clinician cannot trace a diagnosis to a physiological pathway or intervene on one. We propose TRACE, a Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG, whose 32-dimensional clinical latent space is specified in advance from domain knowledge rather than discovered by optimization. TRACE partitions this space into perfusion, structure, and conduction subspaces, routes each to its own diagnostic head by design, regularizes the partition with an orthogonality penalty, and reconstructs the ECG through a decoder that permits latent perturbation. translated_title: TRACE：面向临床心电图的易处理路由自编码器
translated_abstract: 深度学习已经推动了自动化心电图（ECG）诊断的发展，但该领域最精确的模型——在数百万条记录上预训练的基础模型——其决策路径不可审计：临床医生无法将诊断追溯到某一生理通路，也无法针对某一通路进行干预。我们提出了TRACE，一种面向临床心电图的易处理路由自编码器，其32维临床潜在空间是根据领域知识预先指定的，而非通过优化发现的。TRACE将该空间划分为灌注、结构和传导三个子空间，通过设计将每个子空间路由到各自的诊断头，并利用正交性惩罚对划分进行正则化，同时通过一个允许潜在扰动的解码器重建心电图。在PTB-XL和Georgia数据集上，TRACE超越了无约束分类器，并在约……（通过线性探针在冻结特征上评估）领先于在一个千万条记录上预训练的心电图基础模型。
tldr: TRACE是一种决策路径可审计的临床心电图诊断模型，其32维潜在空间由领域知识预先定义并划分为灌注、结构和传导三个子空间，在PTB-XL和Georgia数据集上超越了无约束分类器以及在一个千万条记录上预训练的心电图基础模型。
en_tdlr: TRACE is a decision-pathway-auditable clinical ECG diagnosis model whose 32-dimensional latent space is pre-specified from domain knowledge and partitioned into perfusion, structure, and conduction subspaces, outperforming unconstrained classifiers and an ECG foundation model pretrained on ten million recordings on PTB-XL and Georgia.
